source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: ليلة الخميس، اتفقنا نسهر عند صاحبنا سامي.
sentences.en: Thursday night, we agreed to hang out at our friend Sami's place.

sentences.ar: كل واحد جاب شي: واحد حلويات وواحد فواكه.
sentences.en: Everyone brought something: one sweets and one fruit.
We sat in the living room drinking tea and talking.
We told jokes and laughed until late at night.

sentences.ar: سامي طلع العود وصار يعزف ويغني.
sentences.en: Sami got out the oud and started playing and singing.
We all sang old songs with him.

sentences.ar: بنص الليل، عملنا قهوة وكملنا السهرة.
sentences.en: In the middle of the night, we made coffee and continued the evening.

sentences.ar: نسينا الوقت وصرنا نحكي عن المستقبل.
sentences.en: We lost track of time and started talking about the future.
We went to our homes early in the morning, happy.
